title: Statuz Arrow Map
description: JSON Schema for an Arrow Map — a portable, executable description of a niche topology. A collection of StatuNodes and Arrows that captures the living structure of a system.

arrow_map_version.description: Schema version of the Arrow Map specification

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this Arrow Map. Used to reference the map across projects.

name.description: Human-readable name for this Arrow Map

description.description: What this topology represents and what it is used for

niche_category.description: The category of niche this map describes

version.description: Semantic version of this specific Arrow Map instance

status.description: Lifecycle status of this Arrow Map

arrows.description: All directed relationships between nodes in this topology

namespaces.description: Namespace resolution map for node IDs. Maps short IDs to full URIs.

invariants.description: Topological invariants — rules that must always hold in this map

expression.description: Optional machine-readable expression of the invariant

severity.description: What happens when this invariant is violated

templates.description: Template parameters for instantiating this map. Makes the map reusable across projects.

default.description: Default value if not provided during instantiation

required.description: Whether this parameter must be provided

extends.description: Other Arrow Maps this map extends or composes. Enables map inheritance.

map_id.description: ID of the parent Arrow Map

version.description: Specific version of the parent map to use

override.description: Whether this map can override nodes/arrows from the parent

storage.description: Storage configuration for this Arrow Map. Maps are independent of projects and can be stored in multiple locations.

canonical_path.description: The canonical storage location for this map

registry.description: The registry or namespace where this map is published

local_cache.description: Local file path where this map is cached when referenced by projects

license.description: License for this map (if shared publicly)

source_url.description: URL to the canonical source of this map
